(1) None is attested for land or for a map on ur.wikipedia: «زمین کی بلندی و پستی» 0 pages, «بلندی و پستی کا نقشہ» 0, «اونچ نیچ کا نقشہ» 0, «ابھرے ہوئے خد و خال» 0, «ابھرا ہوا نقشہ» 0; the bare pair «بلندی و پستی» has 2 pages whose titles (الرافع, آدم (اسلام)) are not about land or maps, and the bare «اونچ نیچ» was weighed in N750. (2) «ابھرا ہوا» / «ابھرے ہوئے» says raised or embossed, a physical relief model, where the Arabic «التضاريس» and the English 'terrain' name the ground's relief and the page is a screen map. (3) The title is the published ui.map.terrain («زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ») minus «تین جہتی»; any of these would split one site name in two and is a site-wide amendment, which stays N333's one-line option for the owner (a plainer phrase, if the owner decides on a site-wide rename), not a page edit. N750 stands: nativeness -5 and fit -2 on the two keys stay charged (92).

source_defects.defect: The form and the thank-you page say nothing about whether a reply comes or when (the label offers 'if you would like a reply'), and the note says 'none of it is published' without saying what happens to the email. Reader #25, #26, #30. The Urdu keeps faith; no promise of a reply, a period or a use of the email was added. Round 3: reader r2 #21 meets the same silence.

The toggle labels are bare noun phrases ('3D view' / '2D view') and the template shows the label of the other mode, so a reader cannot tell whether a label names the view now on or the view a press leads to (reader #51). A verb or a state word would be a change of the source and the template.

The English hints say only 'Ctrl + scroll' / '⌘ + scroll' (no direction, no wheel); the Arabic Windows hint names the mouse wheel and its Mac hint does not (stage 4, divergence 2). Reader #50 could not tell scroll from pan. Round 3: reader r2 #39 asks again whether one verb serves scroll and move; the English itself uses two verbs and the Urdu has one.

The page lists six of the twelve components, with numbers that skip (1563-004 … 1563-012), and the other six are named nowhere (reader #3, #5). Neither source explains the gaps; the sentence 'in the order of their component numbers' is all they say. Round 3: reader r2 #16 asks the same question.

Published Urdu already on the owner's list (open item published-ur-labels-flagged) is hit again by a fifth reader: «آبی اجسام» in the lake summary (r1 #12), «اپنی طرز کے» in the Qaisariyah summary (#7), «حساوی لیموں کا باغ» under the farm category (#37). Nothing in this batch changes them.

The published Urdu summary of the Khuzam fort (src/content/attractions/khuzam.md, summary_ur) reads «ہفوف کے مغربی کنارے پر پہلی سعودی ریاست کا ایک قلعہ۔»; «مغربی کنارہ» is the Urdu name of the West Bank (ur.wikipedia article «مغربی کنارہ», HTTP 200), and the reader (r1 #8, medium) took it that way. Out of scope for this batch; option for the owner with the open published-label round: «ہفوف کے مغربی سرے پر» or «مغربی حصے میں». Not edited.
